in_marathi.name: Ameyatma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ameyatma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ameyatma is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Ameya’ meaning ‘immortal’ and ‘Atma’ meaning ‘soul’. The name signifies the eternal soul that exists beyond physical life.
